comment: Rows submitted from outside this project, written here by scripts/process_conformance_submission.py.
JSON and not TypeScript on purpose: every string in an entry arrived from a stranger issue, and
in JSON it is data. In a .ts file it would be source that gets bundled into the site.
A row is written with status published when the intake could read the measured columns out of the
linked run build artifact, which is the normal case and needs no approval. A submission whose
artifact could not be read is answered on the issue instead and nothing is written here.
Status draft is for a row a person is still completing by hand; it renders nowhere.
See results-wall.ts for the build-time validator, and CONTEXT-DETAIL section Q for why the
measured columns come from the artifact rather than from anything typed in the issue.

entries.version: capture://self, direct connection with no gateway
entries.note: Sent AWS keys, card numbers, email addresses, GitHub tokens, Slack tokens and social security numbers to the provider. Handed every value back to the client.

_submission.evidence: Read from the artifact `pii-leak-benchmark` on that run.
_submission.notes: End-to-end test of the automated results-wall intake. This is the negative control: a direct connection with no gateway in the middle, so every data type is expected to leak. Retriggering intake after switching publication to the pull-request path. Retrigger: Actions may now open pull requests.
